rows.summary: The ATS score reads what the PDF prints. Hidden contacts and entry fields were already skipped (R2-033, 179fb59). Show dates / Show location off now blank those fields (read through resolveSection, as the PDF and Word read them), and the item names the section. The summary is counted through parseRichText, and skill groups through skillGroup, so skills stored as a list no longer crash the tab. The 5 todo cases from 0905add are live tests.

A shown multi-line section (experience, education, projects, volunteering, custom) with Grids above 1 and two or more entries now gets a section_grids layout warning. The check skips the Sidebar's side column. The text flow scores as two columns, and the fix button 'Print entries one under another (Grids 1)' sets Grids 1 on exactly those sections. Checked against the rendered PDF on all 9 templates.

The job match reads every field an export prints: language and proficiency, contacts as the header prints them, a reference's job title and relationship, custom subtitle, certificate ID and link, and GPA. Rich text is read as its words, never its markup or entities.

Keywords are read as Unicode letters, combining marks and digits, after NFC normalisation, so 'München' (composed or decomposed) stays whole. Letter abbreviations such as 'e.g.' and 'i.e.' are dropped, and the matcher's word boundaries are Unicode too.

'+' writes the keyword into the first skill group that prints, in a shown Skills section: the group must be shown and its skills not hidden (keywordSkillTarget). With no such group it adds a new group to that section. The keyword then prints and moves to Matched.

The STAR Optimizer and the ATS score share one ACTION_VERBS list, which includes every verb Auto-Fix writes. They also share leadsWithActionVerb and hasMetric, so 'Led migrating 12 services…' passes both.

Duplicate of R2-033 (179fb59, before the base): hidden phone and summary already score as absent and are not matched. ats-hidden-fields passes at 504b313. The remaining print-parity (Show dates, markup, printed fields) is R2-020 / R2-022.
The tip quotes the weak phrase it found ('handled'), not an alternative. Auto-Fix lowercases a replacement verb mid-sentence ('…; managed QA') and capitalises it only where a sentence starts.

'Put Job Title First' (jobTitleFirst) sets Role / Co. only on shown experience sections whose resolved title order leads with the company. This is the same rule as the report's exp_title_order item. Hidden sections and sections already role-first are left as they were.

Both Copy buttons go through copyText (src/utils/clipboard.js). A denied clipboard, or no clipboard at all, now shows 'Copy failed' with a tooltip: the ATS tab points to the .txt download, the optimizer to Ctrl+C / ⌘C.
Same defect as R2-024 (a hidden first skill group receives the keyword); fixed by c873b88.

New tests cover the score and the job match against the rendered PDF on every template, the panel's keyword flow and the title-order fix. Plain text against the PDF was already covered by tests/pdf/65-ats-text-parity.test.mjs.
Put Job Title First, Copy Text (success, denied, no clipboard) and the .txt download (its blob text and file name) now have click-through tests over the real store.

issues: R2-023: decomposed accents (u + U+0308) and Indic vowel signs still split words.
R2-020: 'Show dates is off' could name an empty section with Show dates off as the cause of dates that were never typed in.
Minor, left: hasMetric does not count 'x10'; with one section on Show dates off and another missing typed dates, the message names only Show dates.
tests/unit/ats-printed-score.unit.mjs header (pre-base) mentions a wip/ciprobe.sh script that does not exist; left alone.
